As a result, it was decided that this station would be inserted onto . However, it should also be noted that this rule did not apply for passengers from Old Brightland Station as and of Nawis Railway were already available at the time.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Gt186l1kMs&t=475s</ref>

  • A Corroded Cave exists to the southeast of this station in a fashion similar to Barode Cave Station. As a result, the road to the south of this station avoids that cave.
